Welcome to My Blog This is my first post on this blog, and I’m using Hugo with the PaperMod theme. In this post, I’ll also demonstrate mathematical formulas using KaTeX and code blocks.
What is Hugo? Hugo is a fast and modern static site generator. It’s easy to set up, and you can use it to create blogs, portfolios, or even documentation sites.
Features of PaperMod: Lightweight and fast. Highly customizable. Supports dark mode. Client-side search with FlexSearch. Built-in social media sharing. Mathematical Formulas You can write mathematical formulas using KaTeX. Here’s an example of inline math:
The Pythagorean theorem is $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.
For block-level math, you can use:
$$ E = mc^2 $$
Code Block Example Here is a simple Python code example that prints “Hello, World!”:
1 2 # This is a simple Python script print("Hello, World!") And here’s an example of a JavaScript function:
1 2 3 function greet() { console.log("Hello, World!"); } Thanks for reading!
